messages:
ana: Heads-up onboarding LyraX-8B (Mistral lineage) to int4 perf suite. Seeing strong repeating tokens in long summarization runs after ~2k tokens.

sam: Repro please? share prompt + command.

ana: Minimal repro: `python run_gen.py --model lyrax-8b --quant int4 --max-tokens 2500 --seed 42 --task summarization`. Behavior: starts repeating 'the benefits of the' around token ~2132 and loops.

carla: fp16 baseline clean with same seed?

ana: fp16 clean. int8 occasionally noisy, int4 deterministic loop.

dmitri: Could be head-order/proj-order or rotary mapping mismatch after conversion. Any conversion warnings?

ana: Logs: `WARN: rotary_scale mismatch default(1.0)->0.9 for head groups` and `info: proj_order preserved`. KV cache trace: `kvcache_head_offset +1` for some heads.

sam: Try forcing a head-swap in runtime to test: `--head-order swap:3,7`. If repeats lessen, it's ordering.

ana: Swap patch reduced repeats but ROUGE dropped ~0.8 vs fp16.

carla: Also check tokenizer normalization (NFKC vs NFD). Mistral-derived vocab sometimes uses composed vs decomposed accents causing token boundary drift in long contexts.

ana: Token diff shows 23 mismatched splits; many involve ZWJ and composed accents.

node-bot: eval-run queued: #5421 (fp16 vs int4 variants) ETA ~15m :hourglass:.

ana: Runtime logs: `kvcache: head=3 offset=1; rotary: angle_wrap head=7; kv_index mismatch step 2100`.

dmitri: If tokenizer fix reduces id drift, that helps. Two mitigations: (1) short-term fallback to int8 for long requests, (2) long-term: fix conversion script + add NFKC normalizer.

ana: Implemented runtime fallback flag `--quant-fallback-threshold 1500` to switch to int8 for requests > threshold. Opened PRs: convert mapping patch and tokenizer-normalizer.

node-bot: eval 5421 completed: fp16 ROUGE-L=42.1; int4(raw)=38.6; int4+swap=40.3; int4+tokenfix=41.7; int4+fallback=41.8.

carla: Fallback looks best quality-wise. Latency/cost impact?

ana: p50 +8ms, p99 +120ms on 2k-token runs when fallback triggers. Cost delta +18% for those requests.

dmitri: Acceptable interim. Plan: land tokenizer normalizer + conversion fix, enable fallback feature-flag for lyrax-int4 in staging, run 72h smoke, promote to canary if stable. If tokenfix makes int4 stable, disable fallback.

sam: Add regression test: `tests/onboard/lyrax_longctx_repro.txt` and CI check for headmap roundtrip.

ana: Done. PRs: convert#1234, tokenizer#1235, runtime-fallback#1236. Node-bot updated checklist.

node-bot: deploy-checklist updated: `lyrax-int4-fallback` feature flag added to staging and canary.

ana: Locking plan and will alert eng-sre if error rate >2x baseline. repro curl: `curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d @repro_lyrax_longctx.json`.

carla: Also add sliding-window perplexity job to onboarding harness to detect early drift.

dmitri: I'll add that job.

sam: :thumbsup:
